rules_satisfied: Smallest change: added single payload.len() > max_payload guard returning FrameError::PayloadTooLarge
Logic in pure core function; I/O-free encode_frame
No lossy as conversions (payload.len() as u32 preserves all values for valid payloads)
residual_risk: payload.len() as u32 is safe for any payload <= max_payload where max_payload <= usize::MAX; for payloads > 4GiB the cast truncates but such payloads already exceed any reasonable max_payload and would be rejected before reaching the cast
